headline: Helps reduce sebum and pores, and even skin tone
subhead: Matmarine, a marine-derived biotech extract, helps regulate oiliness and reduce the appearance of pores.
proof_points: Niacinamide from Lonza, Switzerland; Matmarine from Lipotec USA
Lightweight serum with Zinc, no sticky residue
2-3 drops after cleansing and toning, AM & PM
footnote: Evaluated for safety through patch testing under the supervision of a Dermatologist.
